    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于 RO2 humble 配置 robosense Helios 32（速腾） &amp; xsense mti 300</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p>博客地址：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>雷达型号：robosense Helios 32（速腾）</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>IMU 型号：xsense mti 300</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>使用环境： RO2 humble</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>首先将雷达以及 IMU 都连接到电脑上</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403215257490-64281046.jpg" alt="89b18efddb314f927575a6029758a2dd" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="配置-robosense-helios-32速腾">配置 robosense Helios 32（速腾）</h1>
<h2 id="查看雷达-ip-地址">查看雷达 IP 地址</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>安装辅助工具</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo apt install wireshark-qt

</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403215509878-316521053.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-03_20-46-38" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>启动辅助工具</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo wireshark

</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403215435947-1962078598.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403215340913-1792424499.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-03_20-51-27" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>记录下 Who 和 Tell 后面的 IP 地址</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>Who 是要给电脑设置的 IP 地址</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>Tell 是雷达自身的 IP 地址</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="在网页中访问雷达-ip-地址">在网页中访问雷达 IP 地址</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403215554052-2107785323.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-03_20-54-01" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403215619270-1267138382.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-03_21-32-27" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>记录下这些配置</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="为电脑配置-ip-地址">为电脑配置 IP 地址</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403215737352-758001432.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-03_21-26-18" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403215853260-1540757107.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-03_21-26-29" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="测试电脑能否-ping-通雷达">测试电脑能否 ping 通雷达</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403215724627-268488819.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-03_20-54-39" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="配置-xsense-mti-300">配置 xsense mti 300</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>为 IMU 的 USB 接口赋予权限</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403215655048-1331253839.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-03_21-44-32" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">ls /dev/tty  # 双击 Tab 键

sudo chmod 777 /dev/ttyUSB0

</code></pre>
<h1 id="下载并编译驱动功能包">下载并编译驱动功能包</h1>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404162133075-1963236297.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-04_10-24-32" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="下载并编译雷达驱动功能包">下载并编译雷达驱动功能包</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo apt install libpcap-dev libyaml-cpp-dev

sudo apt-get update

</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mkdir -p driver_ws/src

cd driver_ws/src

git clone https://github.com/RoboSense-LiDAR/rslidar_sdk.git

cd rslidar_sdk

git submodule init

git submodule update

</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd driver_ws/src

git clone https://github.com/RoboSense-LiDAR/rslidar_msg.git

</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd driver_ws

colcon build

</code></pre>
<h2 id="下载并编译-imu-驱动功能包">下载并编译 IMU 驱动功能包</h2>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://github.com/xsenssupport/Xsens_MTi_ROS_Driver_and_Ntrip_Client/tree/ros2" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">参考文档</a></p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd /home/zylyehuo/Downloads

git clone --branch ros2 https://github.com/xsenssupport/Xsens_MTi_ROS_Driver_and_Ntrip_Client.git

</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404162513383-279163388.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>将下载下来的项目中的 ros2 驱动复制到工作空间的 src 路径下</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404162743411-1986897687.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo apt install ros-$ROS_DISTRO-nmea-msgs

sudo apt install ros-$ROS_DISTRO-mavros-msgs

</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404163957873-1744538125.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd driver_ws/src

sudo chmod -R o+rw xsens_mti_ros2_driver/

cd ..

pushd src/xsens_mti_ros2_driver/lib/xspublic &amp;&amp; make &amp;&amp; popd

colcon build

</code></pre>
<h1 id="测试">测试</h1>
<h2 id="雷达与-imu-时间同步">雷达与 IMU 时间同步</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404152510776-1935209633.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404152651169-634843506.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo ptp4l -m -i enp11s0 -S

</code></pre>
<h2 id="测试-robosense-helios-32速腾">测试 robosense Helios 32（速腾）</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403214750765-1864905574.jpg" alt="2b177cbb8d1d307de3ca44f422b220f4" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="修改-configyaml-配置文件">修改 config.yaml 配置文件</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>与雷达网页上记录的配置参数相对应</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403220037143-1054980113.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-03_21-49-15" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">common:
  msg_source: 1                         # 0: not use Lidar
                                        # 1: packet message comes from online Lidar
                                        # 2: packet message comes from ROS or ROS2
                                        # 3: packet message comes from Pcap file
  send_packet_ros: false                # true: Send packets through ROS or ROS2(Used to record packet)
  send_point_cloud_ros: true            # true: Send point cloud through ROS or ROS2
lidar:
  - driver:
      lidar_type: RSHELIOS  # RSM1             #  LiDAR type - RS16, RS32, RSBP, RSAIRY, RSHELIOS, RSHELIOS_16P, RS128, RS80, RS48, RSP128, RSP80, RSP48, 
                                   #               RSM1, RSM1_JUMBO, RSM2, RSM3, RSE1, RSMX.
                                   
      msop_port: 6698  # 6699              #  Msop port of lidar
      difop_port: 7789  # 7788             #  Difop port of lidar
      imu_port: 0                  #  IMU port of lidar(only for RSAIRY, RSE1), 0 means no imu.
                                   #  If you want to use IMU, please first set ENABLE_IMU_DATA_PARSE to ON in CMakeLists.txt 
      user_layer_bytes: 0          #  Bytes of user layer. thers is no user layer if it is 0         
      tail_layer_bytes: 0          #  Bytes of tail layer. thers is no tail layer if it is 0


      min_distance: 0.2            #  Minimum distance of point cloud
      max_distance: 200            #  Maximum distance of point cloud
      use_lidar_clock: true        #  true--Use the lidar clock as the message timestamp
                                   #  false-- Use the system clock as the timestamp
      dense_points: false          #  true: discard NAN points; false: reserve NAN points
      
      ts_first_point: true         #  true: time-stamp point cloud with the first point; false: with the last point;   
                                   #  these parameters are used from mechanical lidar

      start_angle: 0               #  Start angle of point cloud
      end_angle: 360               #  End angle of point cloud

                                   #  When msg_source is 3, the following parameters will be used
      pcap_repeat: true            #  true: The pcap bag will repeat play   
      pcap_rate: 1.0               #  Rate to read the pcap file
      pcap_path: /home/robosense/lidar.pcap #The path of pcap file

    ros:
      ros_frame_id: rslidar                           #Frame id of packet message and point cloud message
      ros_recv_packet_topic: /rslidar_packets          #Topic used to receive lidar packets from ROS
      ros_send_packet_topic: /rslidar_packets          #Topic used to send lidar packets through ROS
      ros_send_imu_data_topic: /rslidar_imu_data         #Topic used to send imu data through ROS
      ros_send_point_cloud_topic: /rslidar_points      #Topic used to send point cloud through ROS
      ros_queue_length: 100                            #Topic QoS history depth

</code></pre>
<h3 id="启动-launch-文件进行测试">启动 launch 文件进行测试</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403214759510-1132784811.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-03_21-47-16" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260403215918962-1381238709.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-03_21-30-42" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd driver_ws

source install/setup.bash

ros2 launch rslidar_sdk humble_start.py

</code></pre>
<h3 id="tips速腾雷达可以选择点的类型">Tips：速腾雷达可以选择点的类型</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>参考链接：<a href="https://www.codeleading.com/article/92325088976/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">速腾聚创雷达最新驱动安装（包含ring和timestamp）运行lio-sam</a></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404165848938-136739009.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404165905663-971979985.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>保存好之后，重新编译即可</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="测试-xsense-mti-300">测试 xsense mti 300</h2>
<h3 id="基于-mt软件套测试">基于 MT软件套测试</h3>
<h4 id="1安装依赖">1.安装依赖</h4>
<h5 id="安装-libdouble-conversion1">安装 libdouble-conversion1</h5>
<pre><code class="language-bash">wget http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/d/double-conversion/libdouble-conversion1_2.0.1-4ubuntu1_amd64.deb

sudo dpkg -i libdouble-conversion1_2.0.1-4ubuntu1_amd64.deb

</code></pre>
<h5 id="安装-libicu60">安装 libicu60</h5>
<pre><code class="language-bash">wget http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/i/icu/libicu60_60.2-3ubuntu3.2_amd64.deb

sudo dpkg -i libicu60_60.2-3ubuntu3.2_amd64.deb

</code></pre>
<h4 id="2mt软件套下载">2.MT软件套下载</h4>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://www.xsens.com/support/software-documentation" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">下载链接</a></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404161236808-273494682.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-04_09-39-40" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404161248161-1419104572.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-04_09-40-23" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 id="3执行sh文件">3.执行.sh文件</h4>
<blockquote>
<p>将刚才下载的压缩文件手动解压，并将一共有三个文件需要解压，大文件解压后，点进去还有两个文件需要解压，解压完后将压缩包删了节省内存。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404161301686-547797491.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-04_11-53-47" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404161310802-482233311.jpg" alt="Snipaste_2026-04-04_11-54-23" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">./mtsdk_linux-x64_2022.0.sh 

</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>若报错“uudecond”，执行以下安装命令</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo apt-get update -y
 
sudo apt-get install -y sharutils

</code></pre>
<h4 id="4打开mt-manager界面">4.打开MT Manager界面</h4>
<blockquote>
<p>打开到以下路径的文件：</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>MT_Software_Suite_linuxx64_2022.0_b7085_r119802/MT_Software_Suite_linux-x64_2022.0/mtmanager_linux-x64_2022.0/mtmanager/linux-x64/bin</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>然后右键打开终端，执行如下命令</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-bash">./mtmanager

</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404160941463-946339641.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404163322811-1811793312.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404163344465-831832755.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404162932158-1953368151.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404163251978-58869825.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>记住这步设置的波特率</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="运行-launch-文件测试-imu--节点数据">运行 launch 文件测试 IMU  节点数据</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">lsusb

</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>看到Xscens ******</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404164153905-1772971375.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">ls -l /dev/tty  # 双击 Tab 键
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>看到/dev/ttyUSB0</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404164318022-739960187.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo chmod 777 /dev/ttyUSB0

</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404164420845-1981456181.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">groups
 
sudo usermod -G dialout -a $USER
 
newgrp dialout

</code></pre>
<h4 id="单纯发布imu的节点数据">单纯发布IMU的节点数据</h4>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404164918560-237261182.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd driver_ws

source install/setup.bash
        
roslaunch xsens_mti_driver xsens_mti_node.launch
</code></pre>
<h4 id="在-rviz-中可视化-imu-数据">在 rviz 中可视化 IMU 数据</h4>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202604/3071480-20260404165146719-106698068.jpg" alt="f777b6ee5b667095b47090e333174a9b" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">ros2 launch xsens_mti_ros2_driver display.launch.py

</code></pre>
